sections.text: Payment terms: Customer shall pay each invoice within 30 days of the invoice date (Net 30).
Customer ID: 100234. Billing Entity: Acme Corporation, 500 Market St, San Francisco, CA.
For Product X, Customer shall have 60 days from the invoice date to pay (Net 60).
This Renewal supersedes and overrides all prior payment terms applicable to Product X, including any conflicting terms in the original Master Service Agreement.
Payment terms: Customer shall pay each invoice within 45 days of the invoice date (Net 45).
Customer ID: 220987. Billing Entity: Globex Incorporated, 1 Industrial Way, Austin, TX.
Payment terms: Customer shall pay each invoice within 30 days of the invoice date (Net 30).
This Amendment No. 1 expands the scope of services to include quarterly on-site support. It is silent as to payment terms, which are not addressed by this Amendment.

This Amendment No. 2 reinstates the original 30-day payment term (Net 30) for all products and services, notwithstanding any interim silence in Amendment No. 1, and supersedes any inconsistent interpretation arising therefrom.
